headline: Rollins (ROL) Stock May Look Reasonable On Cash Flow While Earnings Stay Rich
summary: Rollins stock has fallen 34.7% year to date, yet the latest intrinsic value estimate from a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model points to meaningful upside while traditional market multiples still make the shares look expensive, creating a clear split between valuation frameworks. The share price is down 34.7% since the start of the year, which puts Rollins firmly in the bracket of stocks where sentiment has turned and valuation is under fresh scrutiny.
